about_short_description.short_description: Avina is a proprietary AI companion that leads sellers from their first encounter to their final email.

product.name: Signals
product.description: A platform that captures and delivers real-time buying signals from multiple sources to sales and marketing teams for prioritizing outreach and pipeline development.

product.name: Actions
product.description: A service that converts buying signals into actionable sales activities by syncing data to CRMs, drafting communications, and automating sales sequences.

product.name: Inbox
product.description: A unified inbox that consolidates all buying signals in one place, allowing sales teams to monitor and act on opportunities efficiently.

product.name: Briefs and Meeting Bot
product.description: A tool that prepares sales reps for meetings by providing pre-call briefs and post-call summaries with follow-up email drafts.
